description: Part 108 BVLOS Ground Risk Tiers based on Census Tract Population Density (people per square mile)

tiers.name: Sparsely Populated / Rural
tiers.description: Unpopulated or agricultural land. Lowest ground hazard risk.

tiers.name: Low Density Suburban
tiers.description: Suburban residential and light commercial. Moderate ground hazard risk.

tiers.name: Medium Density Residential
tiers.description: Medium urban / dense residential zones. Increased mitigation required.

tiers.name: High Density Urban
tiers.description: Dense urban commercial and residential corridors. High risk.

tiers.name: Dense Urban Core
tiers.description: Metropolitan downtown core / critical infrastructure. Maximum ground risk.
